properties.name: ratelimit.default-duration
properties.description: Default time window for rate limiting.

properties.name: ratelimit.default-limit
properties.description: Default number of requests allowed within the duration.

properties.name: ratelimit.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable rate limiting globally.

properties.name: ratelimit.endpoints
properties.description: Custom limits for specific endpoints. Key: endpoint path, Value: max requests per duration

properties.name: ratelimit.exceeded-message
properties.description: Message returned when rate limit is exceeded.
properties.defaultValue: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.

properties.name: ratelimit.exceeded-status-code
properties.description: HTTP status code when rate limit is exceeded.

properties.name: ratelimit.include-headers
properties.description: Include rate limit headers in response.

values.description: Fixed window: Resets counter at fixed intervals.
Sliding window: Smoothly moves the time window.
Token bucket: Allows bursts up to bucket size.
